data.name: Bloodline Arcana
data.description: Whenever you fail a concentration check to cast a spell, a cantrip effect is created. Randomly determine one of your cantrips known (for example, if you know 6 cantrips, roll 1d6). There is a 50%% chance this cantrip affects a target of your choice within 60 feet; otherwise it affects you.
